test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question: Which of the following statements contradicts the writer’s view?

options.text: The actors of Blind Opera imitate others easily.
The blind dream in colour despite their disability.
Blind children should enter the mainstream from the beginning.
As a united community, the disabled can demand better facilities.

solution:
​The correct answer is "**The actors of Blind Opera imitate others easily**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **theme **of the comprehension passage is about blind opera, challenges overcome by blind opera members to impress the audience, and the purpose to reach the larger community of people with blindness who live in isolation. They want to establish a drama school that caters to all those who are economically and socially forced to stay on the periphery.
 
• In the **third **paragraph of the comprehension, it is stated that they respond instinctively; they cannot copy anyone else because they cannot see. Their body language tells the story and hence it is very spontaneous.

**Hence, the correct answer is option 1**
